common.description: Common is the pagination and ordering options that are common to all the List methods.

workspaceRef.description: WorkspaceRef returns only the snapshots of this Workspace.

spaceRef.description: SpaceRef returns only the snapshots whose source Workspace belongs to this Space.

ListWorkspaceSnapshotOptions.title: List Workspace Snapshot Options
ListWorkspaceSnapshotOptions.description: ListWorkspaceSnapshotOptions is the request of the ListWorkspaceSnapshot method. The returned WorkspaceSnapshots are always restricted to the ones that are owned by the calling User.

page.description: Page is the page number, starts at zero.

itemsPerPage.description: ItemsPerPage is the items per page

octelium.api.main.meta.v1.CommonListOpti.title: Common List Options
octelium.api.main.meta.v1.CommonListOpti.description: CommonListOptions is the listing options that are common to every List request.

type.title: Type
type.description: Type is the field by which the list is ordered

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Mode is the direction in which the list is ordered

octelium.api.main.meta.v1.CommonListOpti.title: Order By
octelium.api.main.meta.v1.CommonListOpti.description: OrderBy sets the ordering of the returned list

apiVersion.description: APIVersion is the API version of the reference resource

kind.description: Kind is the resource kind. A kind is unique per an APIVersion.

uid.description: UID is the resource object UID. A UID is unique across the entire Cluster.

name.description: Name is the resource object name. A name is unique per a certain kind.

resourceVersion.description: ResourceVersion is the resourceVersion of the resource.

octelium.api.main.meta.v1.ObjectReferenc.title: Object Reference
octelium.api.main.meta.v1.ObjectReferenc.description: ObjectReference is a reference to another Cluster resource. It identifies the referenced resource by its kind and either its UID or its name.
